meta.name: geo-optimizer
meta.description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — make content rank in AI search answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Audits existing content, rewrites for AI citation, and produces per-engine strategy. Use when asked to "optimize for AI search", "rank in ChatGPT", "GEO audit", "improve AI citations", "rank in Perplexity", "AI Overview optimization", "AI Overview ranking", "LLM SEO", "answer engine optimization", "AEO", "get cited by AI", "GEO", "generative engine optimization", "show up in ChatGPT", "appear in AI answers", "be cited by Perplexity", "SGE optimization", "Search Generative Experience", or "make my content show up in AI answers". Distinct from regular SEO — this targets generative engines, not traditional Google rankings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让内容在AI搜索回答中被引用和排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的内容需要出现在ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI搜索的回答中
copy.tagline_en: Make your content rank in AI search answers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your content needs to appear in AI search answers like ChatGPT and Perplexity

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的内容，评估它在 ChatGPT、Perplexity 等 AI 搜索引擎中的可见性，并重写内容以提高被 AI 引用和排名的概率。
howto.when: 当你要求优化 AI 搜索排名、进行 GEO 审计或制定 AI 引擎策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这篇博客的 AI 搜索表现。
say.note: Claude 会分析内容并给出 GEO 评分和改进建议。

say.text: 优化这段文字，让它在 ChatGPT 中更容易被引用。
say.note: Claude 会重写内容，增加数据、引用和结构化标记。

say.text: 为我的网站制定一个 90 天的 AI 引擎优化策略。
say.note: Claude 会生成分阶段行动计划，包括页面优化和权威建设。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze your content, evaluate its visibility in AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity, and rewrite it to increase the chance of being cited and ranked by AI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to optimize for AI search, perform a GEO audit, or develop an AI engine strategy.

say_en.text: Audit this blog post for AI search performance.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and provide a GEO score with improvement suggestions.

say_en.text: Rewrite this text to be more citable by ChatGPT.
say_en.note: Claude will add data, citations, and structured markup.

say_en.text: Create a 90-day GEO strategy for my website.
